summary: Thirteen targets: twelve fresh and Mueller2378 reused, ten prior contexts plus2072 witness checked. No new edges. One actual ant figure, missing Schlagintweit note, third-person Darwin copy, nondecimal pay arithmetic and Bishop response recovery distinguished. No export.
